title: Security Hotfix: Patch public /register endpoint role/center tampering and restrict OAuth user auto-creation
assumptions: ALLOW_PUBLIC_REGISTER defaults to false. When false, public register returns 403 Forbidden.
When ALLOW_PUBLIC_REGISTER is true, user role is forced to 'student' and center_id is forced to None, client cannot specify role or center_id.
Google and Facebook OAuth will only authenticate users whose emails already exist in the database; unknown emails return 403 (no auto-provisioning unassigned students).
